name: Tianzhou-8
about: Tianzhou-8 (2024-211A), a crewed vehicle (Tianzhou), launched 2024 Nov 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2024 Nov 21), held fixed
docked to S48274; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
